description: Manages the creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of user-defined saved filters, allowing users to store and reuse specific search and display criteria across the application.

endpoints.name: CreateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Create a new saved filter. This allows users to store a specific set of filtering criteria for later reuse.

request.description: Filter creation request containing the definition of the new filter.

example_uses: Create a new filter for my project tasks.
Save my current search criteria for future use.
Define a new filter named 'Urgent Items' with specific conditions.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to persist a specific set of filtering criteria, such as search terms, sorting preferences, or column selections, for later retrieval and application.

endpoints.name: UpdateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Update an existing saved filter. This allows modification of a previously saved filter's definition.

request.description: Filter update request containing the modified definition of the filter.

example_uses: Modify the 'Urgent Items' filter to include new conditions.
Update the name of my saved filter from 'Old Name' to 'New Name'.
Change the sorting order for an existing filter.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs to modify the definition, name, or properties of an already existing saved filter.

endpoints.name: DeleteSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Delete a specific saved filter by its ID. This action permanently removes the filter.

id.description: The unique identifier of the filter to delete.

example_uses: Delete the filter with ID 123.
Remove the 'Completed Tasks' filter from my list.
I no longer need this saved filter, please delete it.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to permanently remove a saved filter that is no longer needed.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Retrieve the details of a specific saved filter by its ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the filter to retrieve.

example_uses: Retrieve details for filter ID 456.
Show me the definition of my 'High Priority' filter.
Get the saved filter by its unique identifier to see its criteria.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user needs to view the specific details or configuration of a single saved filter, such as its criteria or name.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilters
endpoints.description: Retrieve a list of saved filters for the current user, with optional filtering and pagination.

request.description: Search and pagination parameters to filter and paginate the list of saved filters.

example_uses: List all my saved filters.
Show me all filters I've created, paginated.
Find saved filters related to 'projects' and sort them by name.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to see a list of all their saved filters, potentially searching for specific ones or navigating through a large collection.

endpoints.name: ApplySavedFilter
endpoints.description: Apply a saved filter by its ID and get the configured filter request object, often used to retrieve data based on the filter's criteria.

id.description: The unique identifier of the filter to apply.

example_uses: Apply filter ID 789 to my current view and get the first page of results.
Use the 'Active Users' filter and retrieve the data it configures.
Get the data configured by a saved filter, specifying page 2 with 20 items per page.
endpoints.when_to_use: When a user wants to apply the criteria defined in a saved filter to retrieve data or configure a view, often with pagination options.

endpoints.name: GetFilterStatistics
endpoints.description: Retrieve usage statistics for saved filters, optionally filtered by entity type.

entityType.description: Optional filter to get statistics for a specific entity type (e.g., 'Projects', 'Tasks').

example_uses: Show me the usage statistics for all saved filters.
How many times has the 'Project X' filter been applied?
Get statistics for filters related to 'tasks' to see their popularity.
endpoints.when_to_use: When an administrator or user wants to understand the usage patterns, popularity, or other statistics related to saved filters.
